'''kpimenatl Court of the Vile Gangster''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[kpimenatl]]
* '''Published:''' 25 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die]]
* '''Strategy:''' I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die kpi.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Bounty Hunters!!! With A little Chomping from the Rancor. Munch, Munch, Munch, LSJK taste good.

== Strategy ==

This deck is simply to overpower your opponent and capture his characters. You retrieve force with the obj. So, there are not to many cards to retrieve force. Capture and feed them to Rancor.
